errors.evidence: The categories on the x-axis are not sorted alphabetically. They are sorted by increasing company size, which is a logical/numerical order, not alphabetical.

errors.text_span: най-високите стълби са за категориите „1000-5000“ (16 участници) и „Над 5000“ (15 участници)
errors.evidence: This statement is misleading. While "1000-5000" is the highest at 16, and "Над 5000" is at 15, the category "До 250" is also at 15. By only mentioning "Над 5000" as one of the highest, it incorrectly implies it holds a unique second-place ranking, omitting that another category has the same value.

The description uses the plural form "най-ниските" (the lowest ones) when referring to the lowest bar. However, there is only one lowest bar, which is for the category "До 50" with a value of 12. Using the plural incorrectly suggests there might be multiple bars at the minimum value.
